title: Credential body cut short of its documented length
description: A value with the right prefix whose body is shorter than the documented length, as left by a copy error or a truncated log line.
semantics: A format contract fixes the body length; a value that does not reach it is not a valid credential of that family, but the same shape one character longer would be. The outcome is therefore set per projection.

applicability.rationale: Only families whose contract fixes a prefix and a body length have a meaningful near miss.

evidenceBasis.rationale: The contract states the body length; a shorter value does not satisfy it.

sources.supports: Documents the exc_live_ prefix and 32-character body.
